t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There re two baskets: one red and one yellow. Which basket appears is dependent on which gnome you select.The gnomes which have red baskets are: red, pink, purple and brown.The gnomes which have yellow baskets are: yellow, orange, blue and green.The amount of points you can gain from each basket differs. The best strategy is to start with the red basket. If the red baskets points begin to decrease, switch to the yellow basket. When the yellow basket is nearly empty (i.e. it only has one or two points left), then switch back to the red basket.

vb_textbox.text: On the screen you will be presented with two gnomes, each of which respectively will produce two different colours of baskets.Each basket is either: i) red, or; ii) yellow.Gnomes which produce RED baskets are the following colours: RED, PINK, PURPLE AND BROWN.Gnomes which produce YELLOW baskets are the following colours: YELLOW, ORANGE, BLUE, GREEN. Each basket allows you to earn a certain amount of points. To earn the maximum amount of points, I found the following strategy to be best:Start by choosing gnomes which produce a RED basket. THE IS THE COLOUR YOU SHOULD AIM FOR UNTIL -.....When the red basket yields zero points, switch to gnomes which produce the YELLOW BASKET, and continue doing so until the yellow basket begins to yield fewer and fewer points (i.e. 2, 1). AT WHICH POINT...Switch back to the RED BASKET and repeat the cycle again.
